name: Forest honey
summary: Mật ong Cát Bà is the island’s forest honey, dark yellow, thick, and fragrant, sold by the households that keep the bees.
culture: The science ministry certified the name Mật ong Cát Bà, and a 2022 workshop set up the “Cát Bà Xanh” mark for the same honey.
taste: Dark yellow, thick, and fragrant. The chiêm-season honey from ong nội bees is counted the best.
howToEat: Buy a bottle straight from a household that sells its own honey.
where: Across the island, including Xuân Đám and Cát Bà town.
